summary: The construction and proof are correct. The profile is concave and positive on the entire Euclidean-ball base, the interval fibers have exact deepest mass a_z/2 at the common singleton 0, and the lattice counting and spherical-cap estimates, including all numerical constants, are valid. The cap estimate excludes every centerpoint outside the plateau for every 0<t<1, while convex-hull separation places every centerpoint in the base for t>=1, so the two branch bounds hold with the stated universal quantifiers. The mass comparisons imply both c_n to 0 and the scalar variational bound. The complete-core argument correctly yields projected-hit depth at least |eta_n|/2, and central symmetry together with the horizontal halfspace gives exact actual mixed depth W_n/2=|eta_n| at the origin.
